title: Friends working on antigravity received threats
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Friends working on antigravity received threats, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You mentioned on Danny Jones that several of your friends worked on antigravity and received a kind of backlash,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, puts a question to Kevin Knuth, a physicist and former NASA scientist. Michels recalls Knuth saying on another podcast, hosted by Danny Jones, that several of his friends worked on antigravity, technology meant to cancel or push against gravity, and got a backlash for it. The suggestion is that research in this area is being discouraged or kept quiet.
